audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[] side disagreed with content win[] on 6 of 7 rows — full mostly said 'Skill' (only Level 3 said Sona); content says Sona wins all 7 rows outright. Full-layer breakdown fields were generic template prose ('chord the contacts', 'aura economy') with no real ability names.
audit.why: Content's reasoning is grounded in real kit facts: attached Yuumi (You and Me!, W) can only react with heals and has no damage aura of her own, so Sona's poke plus sustain wins every stage, and a flanking Crescendo lands clean on her carry because an attached Yuumi cannot peel it. That matches Yuumi's actual passive-support pattern; full-layer text was templated filler that undersold a lane Sona actually dominates.
audit.corrected: Rewrote all 7 phases[].side to 'Sona' (6 changed, Level 3 already correct so left as-is besides its why) and bumped ratings, rewrote each why with the grounded reasoning (content win[] required no edit since it already read all-Sona), and rewrote breakdown.early/mid/cooldowns/trading/feeding/carry/late, ahead, tradeGood, tradeBad, enemyWin, and loading using real ability names (You and Me!, Hymn of Valor, Aria of Perseverance, Song of Celerity, Crescendo, Final Chapter).

audit.why: Level 2 walk-up spike, level 6 Crescendo-vs-Final-Chapter kill threat, and first-item Aria-plus-damage snowball are now correctly reflected in the rewritten phases and breakdown.carry/late.
